message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && printf 'params structured flags
' && grep -n "structured\|STRUCTURED\|PID\|SORT-AS" design-data/vcard-parameters.csv src/libicalvcard/vcardderivedparameter.c.in | sed -n '1,200p' && printf '
prop structured flags
' && grep -n "structured\|ADR\|N," design-data/vcard-properties.csv | sed -n '1,160p' && sed -n '1,80p' design-data/vcard-parameters.csv` executed with exit code 0.
